warmup.description: Activate glutes, hips, and quads while preparing for controlled lower body loading.

main_exercises.name: Goblet Squat
main_exercises.load_guidance: Choose a weight you could perform 12 reps with, stopping at 8-10
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep chest upright and sit hips down between your heels

main_exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell or Barbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load at 7/10 effort, focusing on stretch rather than maximal weight
main_exercises.form_cue: Push hips back and keep a slight bend in knees while maintaining a flat back

main_exercises.name: Reverse Lunges (Dumbbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Use a weight that allows steady balance and control throughout
main_exercises.form_cue: Step back softly and keep front knee tracking over toes

main_exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell or Dumbbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Select a moderate load that allows a strong squeeze at the top of each rep
main_exercises.form_cue: Pause at the top and fully extend hips without arching lower back

main_exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight or light load with full range of motion
main_exercises.form_cue: Control both the lift and the lowering phase for full stretch

cooldown.description: Release tension in hips and legs while promoting recovery.
movements: Seated hamstring stretch x 30s each side
Figure 4 glute stretch x 30s each side
Standing quad stretch x 30s each side

phase_notes.menstrual: This moderate session can feel manageable—reduce load slightly if needed and focus on smooth, controlled movement. Prioritize comfort in exercises like lunges and squats.
phase_notes.follicular: Great time to build momentum—aim to slightly increase load or reps while maintaining good form. You may feel more energized for compound movements.
phase_notes.ovulatory: You can push toward the higher end of the rep ranges with confidence and control. Focus on strong, stable reps especially in unilateral work like lunges.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain steady effort and consistency—this session is well-suited to sustain strength without overreaching. Focus on quality contractions, especially in hip thrusts.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Keep loads moderate and reduce volume if needed—focus on movement quality and controlled tempo. This session works well as a lower-pressure strength day.
